# Epic Games Store

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `dark` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 39 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: dark game-storefront design: the hashed EDS token layer declared outright (784 resolved custom properties: background/foreground/border/accent roles, size, typography, animation, gradient, navigation, control, input) under a #101014 canvas with #18181c/#202024/#303034 elevation steps, #fffffff2/#ffffffa6 text and a #26bbff/#33bfff accent, a 72px egs-navigation web component + 100px tab bar chrome, a hero carousel with card shelves, a legacy Emotion browse grid with a 240px filters rail, a MUI sign-in dialog, an OpenSans marketing surface and a dark support centre.

Captured 2026-11-14, read-only (every captured surface is public: the storefront, the sign-in dialog, the support centre and the marketing home); the sign-in form and both search fields were measured, never submitted; Get, Add to Cart, Wishlist, Download, sort options and filter checkboxes were measured, never activated. Themes: dark.

A token set and component reference for the Epic Games Store's public surfaces — for building dark game-storefront pages, card shelves, product pages and auth dialogs in the style of the real thing. It was read from **store.epicgames.com** and **www.epicgames.com** on **2026-11-14**, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900 and 390 x 844. Captured: the store home (Discover), the legacy Browse grid, the Fortnite product page, Free Games, News, the launcher Download page, the /id sign-in dialog, the /help support centre, the /site marketing home, plus 390px passes on Discover and a product page.

Epic is worth a capture because the store ships its real design system to the browser: the EGS v2 stylesheet declares the hashed **EDS** token layer outright — 784 resolved custom properties (`--color-background-*`, `--color-foreground-*`, `--color-border-*`, `--size-*`, `--typography-*`, `--action-*`, `--gradient*`, `--identity-*`, `--feedback-*`, `--navigation-*`, `--status-*`, `--animation-*`, `--font-*`, `--egs-*`) — plus the older www/help surfaces expose their own shadow-root stylesheets (`:host` rules inside `<egs-navigation>`, `<egs-footer>` and the `epic-wf-*` web components). Every captured surface paints **dark only**: the `#101014` canvas (`--color-background-default`), `#18181c`/`#202024`/`#303034` elevation steps, `#fffffff2`/`#ffffffa6` text, `#ffffff26`/`#ffffff1a` borders and the `#26bbff`/`#33bfff` accent (`--color-background-fill-accent-primary-default`). Inter is the store voice (300-700), Inter Tight the display weight (700/900), OpenSans on www marketing, Recursive Mono for code. **Boundary:** everything behind sign-in was never reached — the sign-in form and both search fields were measured, never submitted; Get, Add to Cart, Wishlist, Download, sort options, filter checkboxes and every provider button were measured, never activated.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do let the EDS layer carry the design.** The store ships its token layer: use `color.background.*`, `color.foreground.*`, `color.border.*`, `size.*` and `typography.*` semantics rather than restating hex. See [tokens.json](tokens.json).
2. **Do spend the blue on actions.** `#26bbff`/`#33bfff` (`color.background.fill-accent-primary-default`) fills Download, Get, Continue and the active tab underline; surfaces stay neutral. See [nav-download](components/crops/nav-download-default.png).
3. **Do stack elevation, not borders.** Cards, fields and the filters rail step through `#18181c`/`#202024`/`#303034` (`color.background.elevated-*`); borders only appear subtle (`#ffffff26`) or as the white `#fff` focus border. See [b-card](components/crops/b-card-default.png) and [s-field-email](components/crops/s-field-email-focused.png).
4. **Do pair Inter with Inter Tight.** Inter owns every control and body (300-700); Inter Tight 700/900 owns the display headings; OpenSans survives on the www marketing surface. See [b-h1](components/crops/b-h1-default.png) and [d-h1](components/crops/d-h1-default.png).
5. **Do use the 9999px pill for CTAs.** Pills (Save Now, Get, Continue, View More) go `size.borderRadius.full`; cards and fields keep small radii. See [hero-cta](components/crops/hero-cta-default.png).
6. **Do treat focus as a border.** Fields and buttons draw the `#fff` `color.border.focus-default` border rather than an outline ring. See [search-field](components/crops/search-field-focused.png).
7. **Don't style the signed-in store from this package.** Library, account, billing, cart and checkout were never reached; the public storefront, the sign-in dialog and the support centre are the evidence.
8. **Don't fabricate a light theme or a purchase.** Every public surface painted dark; no light variant was seen, and Get/Add-to-Cart was measured, never pressed.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- **Three entries read the wrong element.** `m-hamburger` is the "Epic Ecosystem Dropdown" button, not the mobile menu button; `h-chat` is the "Back to top" button, not the chat launcher; `w-tile` read a different carousel tile in each state, so only its default row describes one tile. Recapture needed for all three; no token cites their non-default states.
- **Nine focus-visible states are uncaptured, not ringless.** Keyboard focus did not reach `nav-signin`, `nav-download`, `nav-distribute`, `nav-locale` (inside the `<egs-navigation>` shadow root, which the focus test did not look into), `m-hamburger`, `h-chat`, `hero-cta`, `card-wishlist` and `p-subnav`. Their rows are left out of components.md and listed as Skipped in raw/measurements.md; the capture script now checks `:focus` inside shadow roots (edited, not re-run).
- **Four planned tokens have no reading** and are listed under `_gaps` in raw/component-tokens.json: the free badge and the support tile paint no fill of their own, no mobile drawer component was measured, and the game card's transition computes as 0s.
- **Automation was masked during capture.** Until 2026-11-20, `tools/capture/public/lib.mjs` hid `navigator.webdriver` in every page it opened, so every committed reading was taken with that mask. The mask is removed (a bot check is now recorded as a boundary, not bypassed); whether any page needed it to load is not known, and a recapture without it is the check.
